name: Wes Calhoun
want: sell his two thousand head before the grass gives out and get his men paid
secret: Half the herd isn't his: he gathered unbranded cattle off his neighbours' ranges in the war, and some of those neighbours are on the trail behind him.
voice: A Texas drawl, polite to ladies, insolent to everyone else.
description: A Confederate cavalry veteran who drove a herd north from the Nueces, was turned back at the Missouri line, and drifted west to Salt Lick to wait for a buyer.
appearance: Lean and sunburnt, a big hat, a Confederate shell jacket worn out at the elbows.
